objective: Replace fully downloaded low-resolution Android Wall previews with original-resolution media without blanking images or saturating weak connections
productionBaselineEvidence: Main code baseline is e0de9106; private 384px quality-46 preview sidecars are a first-paint optimization, while fullscreen photo uses the full original. Production OTA adoption and on-device results are not verified.
acceptanceChecks: Wall preview renders fast; after it paints original is loaded and revealed only after valid decode
No blank photo on original fetch/sign failure, offline or weak network
At most two full-resolution mounted upgrade loads; stale queued requests cancel on unmount
Stable original cache key and private signer reused; original photo viewer unchanged
No web/iOS, Supabase Storage/DB, native runtime, APK or production OTA change
Focused regressions, TypeScript and isolated scope gate before integration or release
